messages.subject: Hollis — privileged advice note and strategy
messages.plaintextBody:
Sofia, Maya,

Our advice note is attached (privileged — please keep within the legal/finance circle). In short: the genuine risk is the uncapped protected-disclosure claim, not ordinary unfair dismissal. We recommend opening at a core package around £192,650 gross and reducing the non-compete from 12 to 6 months as a low-cost concession that strengthens the customer/employee non-solicits we actually care about. We'd ask for authority to a ceiling of £215,000 gross on the core taxable package.

Happy to talk it through tomorrow.

Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner, Employment
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
